Application Privacy Policy

Overview

This application enables the creation of Change Requests in ServiceNow using pipeline metadata received from Azure DevOps through ServiceNow REST APIs.

Data Collection

The application receives pipeline-related information from Azure DevOps, such as pipeline metadata, build Id, stage id and stage attempt, via authenticated REST API calls to a ServiceNow import table.

Data Usage

The collected data is used exclusively to create or update Change Request records within the ServiceNow platform for change management automation.

Data Storage

All data is stored only within the customer's ServiceNow instance in application-scoped tables. The application does not store data outside of ServiceNow.

Data Sharing

The application does not share data with any third-party systems or services.

External Data Transfer

Data is transferred from Azure DevOps to ServiceNow using secure HTTPS REST API calls initiated by the customer's Azure DevOps pipeline configuration. No data is transferred from ServiceNow to external systems by this application.

Security

All data access is governed by ServiceNow role-based access control, authentication mechanisms, and platform security controls.
